label: Synthetic benchmark trace. Not customer data.

trace.task: imported from OTel GenAI spans (imported via otel-genai-like)

cost_assumptions.note: Waste calculated as 17300 tokens × 3 repetitions after first occurrence at 2.5/M input tokens. First occurrence (span-001) excluded. Output tokens not counted because waste is on the input side.

findings.evidence: Detection method: block_id_and_similarity. The "OTel prompt: gpt-4o" block (17,300 tokens) appears across 4 model calls. Block ID matched (otel_prompt_6f8f3539) and text similarity confirmed (99%). Block was reused 3 times after first occurrence (span-001).
findings.explanation: The "OTel prompt: gpt-4o" block (17,300 tokens) was included in the model context 4 times but only needed once. After the first use in span-001, the remaining 3 occurrences (span-002, span-003, span-005) passed the same content again, generating an estimated $0.13 in waste. This represents approximately 54% of the total run cost.
findings.recommended_fix: Cache the content of "OTel prompt: gpt-4o" after span-001. Pass a reference ID or cached summary into later steps (span-002, span-003, span-005) instead of the full block.

cost_caveat: The detected repeated-context waste represents a specific measured inefficiency. It does not represent total potential savings. A full cost comparison requires a before-and-after trace pair.
limitations: Synthetic benchmark trace, not customer data.
Cost estimates use published pricing; actual costs may differ.
RunLeak does not guarantee specific savings.
